title: CVE-2022-22965 (Spring4Shell) RCE via WebDataBinder classLoader binding
description: api-svc running spring-webmvc 5.3.16 on JDK 17 / Tomcat 9 is exploitable via Spring4Shell (CVE-2022-22965 / GHSA-36p3-wjmg-h94x). WebDataBinder allows class.module.classLoader parameter binding, enabling attacker to overwrite Tomcat access log pattern and achieve RCE. 234 exploit attempts at 10:00Z. Upgrade to spring-framework 5.3.18 (fix commit 002546b3) required.

title: Upgrade all spring-framework to >= 5.3.18 across all JDK 9+ services
description: CVE-2022-22965 affects Spring Framework < 5.3.18 / < 5.2.20 on JDK 9+. Audit all services for vulnerable versions. Also add DataBinder.setDisallowedFields() to existing Spring MVC controllers as defence-in-depth.
